public_rationale: Neither 'never' assertion can be confirmed by present limitations. The record includes substantial benchmark progress and evidence that premium models retain differentiated demand. Those findings matter, but neither establishes broadly accepted AGI or durable non-commodity economics under the early-resolution rule.
limitations: The NVIDIA result concerns the public set and an augmented agent system.
OpenRouter measures its own platform, not the entire market.
Definitions of AGI, LLM systems, and durable differentiation could affect a future verdict.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs will never be AGI and will never be much more than a commodity.

statement.excerpt: But they will never be AGI, and they never be much more than commodity.
statement.document_title: Three years on, ChatGPT still isn't what it was cracked up to be – and it probably never will be

from_speaker: they never be much more than commodity
our_interpretation: Read 'they' as LLMs and systems whose general capabilities substantially depend on LLMs; flag the unresolved boundary around additional agent machinery.
Read AGI ordinarily as broad, transferable human-level intellectual competence, not success on a single benchmark.
Read 'much more than commodity' as durable capability differentiation and pricing power, not merely different posted prices.
Treat both assertions as indefinite forecasts. Present limitations cannot prove 'never'.
criteria.support_condition: A finite record cannot establish either universal 'never' assertion. Decisive support would require evidence establishing an enduring impossibility, not merely current shortcomings.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying LLM system demonstrably achieves broadly accepted AGI, or LLM markets exhibit durable differentiation and pricing power clearly inconsistent with commodity status.
